annotations.title: Plan a teardown film from a 3D model

description:
[read-only] Teardown Studio: send a 3D model (`model`, base64 STL, 3MF or GLB, up to 3 MB inline) and get its parts list, a default teardown/1 plan (hold, explode, label the biggest parts, slow-motion, reassemble, reveal, brand end card; 16:9 and 9:16) built from part count and bounding boxes, and the render estimate (frames, worker time; free). Rename parts with `names` ({ p0: "Lid" }). Or send an edited `plan` instead of a model to check it against the limits and re-estimate. Nothing is stored, rendered or charged. A model that is not a physical object (status render or prototype) is labelled "3D render" in the film.
(Wraps POST /api/v2/video-studio/templates/teardown/plan.)

engraving.description: Show the NAME engraving placeholder on the reveal.

fileName.description: Helps detect the format, e.g. caddy.stl.

model.description: Base64 of the model file (STL, 3MF or GLB). Send this or `plan`.

plan.description: An edited teardown/1 plan (from an earlier call). Send this or `model`.

status.description: Is this a real, made object? Anything but physical gets a "3D render" label.

name: plan_teardown
title: Plan a teardown film from a 3D model
